maria: Heads up — APAC invoice INV-2026-09 shows ~480 GPU-hours on a legacy reserved pool (commit-id: rsv-PRD-03) that don't match our reported reserved usage. Can someone triage before EOD? :eyes:
ledger-bot: Invoice INV-2026-09 attached • amount $42,300 • lines: `reserved_commit rsv-PRD-03: 720h billed`, `surge_overage: 480h`
tom: I can take ops lead. Is this the 'shadow usage' we saw w/ old node labels? @anika any recent node relabels or pool migrations in APAC?
anika: We rolled `nodepool-reorg-2` last week to move edge nodes to new pools. Did a dry-run but it's possible some workloads still had the old commit tag. Sharing logs now.
anika: ```sh
# quick check to count pods still on old commit tag
kubectl get pods -l commit=rsv-PRD-03 -n apac --no-headers | wc -l
```
suresh: FYI customer HelixHealth pinged CS — they saw the charge and expect bursts capped under their Dedicated commit. They asked for a breakdown and will want an SLA credit if it's our fault.
olivia: HelixHealth is large Q account. If this is our relabel/metric bug we should prepare a goodwill SLA credit and a proforma before we respond.
tom: Ops: can you run a reconcile mapping billed hours -> node UUIDs -> commit tags for Sep 12-18? I'm opening quick ticket TKT-4132.
maria: Also check failover traces around 2026-09-15 03:02 UTC — there was a regional failover that might have triggered burst billing. If this is double-counted we need a reversal.
anika: Found ~470h attributed to the old commit tag in `k8s-migrator` logs. Looks like the prom-labeler didn't backfill historical series for 7 nodes. I can patch labeler to backfill KV.
tom: After backfill, run the usage-recon and hold invoice posting until we confirm root cause.
ledger-bot: Invoice INV-2026-09 status: draft -> posted at 2187654285 by auto-billing. To reverse: `/billing reverse INV-2026-09 --reason 'under review'`
maria: @ledger-bot please hold, @olivia can you pause external billing emails to HelixHealth? We also need a formal SLA credit calc: baseline reserved vs billed surge and the hours to reverse.
olivia: Paused customer billing email for HelixHealth (internal note). Drafting a 20% goodwill credit number pending recon.
suresh: I'll tell the customer we expect an update within 24h and may issue a credit. Keeps them calm.
anika: Backfill started — ETA ~2h. After backfill I'll re-run the recon script and upload results.
tom: Ops run command after backfill: `usage-recon --commit rsv-PRD-03 --range 2026-09-12..2026-09-18 --output csv` and attach the CSV to TKT-4132.
maria: Thanks. Tagging finance for approval to withhold invoice reversal if recon shows system error.
ledger-bot: Note: reversal requires two approvals: `finance-lead` + `billing-ops`. Use `/billing-approve INV-2026-09` once both sign off.
olivia: I'll shepherd approvals and prepare the proforma. Legal not needed yet.
anika: Backfill finished — recon shows 476h attributable to the labeler bug. Uploaded `rsv-PRD-03-recon-218765.csv` to the ticket and flagged lines for reversal. Next steps: finance to reverse invoice and apply SLA credit per policy. @maria
